Computer Science BSc at King's College London

What King's College London asks of applicants to Computer Science BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All King's College London courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 6 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma, Route 1 (offer level A*A*A): three APs at 5 (or permitted Honors/Dual Enrolment classes, IB Higher Levels or A-levels) plus ACT 30 or SAT 1410 (minimum 620 Maths, 650 Reading and Writing)
  • Route 2 needs no SAT/ACT: five APs at 55555
  • SAT subject tests and ACT/SAT superscores are not considered

Chain: the Computer Science BSc course page (2027 entry, standard offer A*A*A) refers US applicants (via its international-qualifications selector) to King’s general Entry Requirements page; that page’s US table is shown here at the A*A*A level. The general page is undated (current). data/courseRequirements.js holds AAA for this course (see the A-Level row).

Verified19 Oct 2026King’s: Undergraduate entry requirements
English language
  • English language band D (2027/28 entry)
  • IELTS Academic (or IELTS Online): 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each skill
  • TOEFL iBT: 92 overall with at least 23 in writing and 20 in each other skill (tests taken from 21 January 2026: 4.5 overall, at least 4 in each skill)
  • PTE Academic: 62 overall with at least 59 in each communicative skill
  • Cambridge C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency: 176 overall with at least 169 in each skill
  • All scores from one test; tests valid within two years of the course start

Nationals of listed majority English-speaking countries (including the USA) who completed an A-level-equivalent qualification in such a country need no additional test.

Verified19 Oct 2026King’s: Computer Science BSc – Entry Requirements · King’s: Undergraduate English language entry requirements
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

King’s lists aptitude tests only for Law/PPL (LNAT), Dentistry/Medicine (UCAT) and Dental Therapy & Hygiene (Casper).

Other qualifications
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: five APs at 55555 (Route 2), or three APs at 5 combined with the ACT/SAT (Route 1)
  • Mathematics/Further Mathematics at grade A → AP Calculus BC at 5
  • AP exams must be taken (AP classes alone do not count); AP Research and AP Seminar are not accepted
